robocode.util

Class RobotCompat

  • java.lang.Object
    • robocode.util.RobotCompat

  • public final class RobotCompat
extends Object
    Used internally by Robocode for keeping existing robots working with the robot security, as these cannot be expected to be updated.

    When robot classes are loaded, calls to the Java classes that these methods replace are replaced with calls to these methods. Robots do not need any changes for this, and should not use this class directly.

    The first two parameters of the methods replacing a constructor are always null. They take the place of the object that the constructor would have initialized and the copy of it, so the replaced instructions have the same length and stack effect.

    Author:
    Flemming N. Larsen (original)

    • Method Detail

      • setUseCache

        public static void setUseCache(boolean useCache)
        Does nothing, as the setting of ImageIO is shared with Robocode. write(RenderedImage, String, OutputStream) never uses a cache file.
        Parameters:
        useCache - ignored.

      • write

        public static boolean write(RenderedImage image,
                            String formatName,
                            OutputStream output)
                     throws IOException
        Writes an image like ImageIO.write(RenderedImage, String, OutputStream), but without a cache file, as robots may only write files in their own data directory.
        Parameters:
        image - the image to write.
        formatName - the name of the image format.
        output - the stream to write to.
        Returns:
        false if there is no writer for the format; true otherwise.
        Throws:
        IOException - if the image cannot be written.

      • stop

        public static void stop(Thread thread)
        Stops a thread of the robot like Thread.stop(). As threads cannot be stopped with Java 20 and newer, the thread is interrupted with these Java versions.
        Parameters:
        thread - the thread to stop.
        Throws:
        SecurityException - if the thread does not belong to the robot.
